scope: Current source/read-only historical warning evidence plus staged test-only API compilation. No production correction, actual trace execution, GPU acceptance or warning-free collection is proved.

failedGuard.failure: Unhandled log message: '[Warning] Ran out of Graphics Ring Buffer space. Consider using the -gfx-ring-buffer-size command line option to increase the size.'. Use UnityEngine.TestTools.LogAssert.Expect
failedGuard.limit: XML attributes a caught warning to this test guard. It does not map each raw emission or identify the responsible probe.

warningEvidence.attributionLimit: All nine emissions lack per-warning frame/time/camera/probe identity in the raw log. Nearest preceding City-load records are context only. The XML interval identifies the catching test guard, not all warning producers; no specific raw ordinal can be assigned from this evidence.

confirmedInputMismatch.currentBuilder: CityBuilder.Probe sets ReflectionProbeTimeSlicingMode.IndividualFaces. All seven saved City probes and the one Bootstrap probe serialize m_TimeSlicingMode1.
confirmedInputMismatch.correction: Exactly three NoTimeSlicing expectations become IndividualFaces. Report wording states that the individualFaces control now re-enables the same authored slicing, not a newly serialized mitigation. No inventory/restoration/range/image/wait/warning guard is relaxed.

sourceLifecycleReview.graphicsOwner: Normal BeginRetirement restores original state and waits for nativePipeline.disposed before destroying owned pipeline/feature/profile objects. Source review finds no confirmed ownership defect.
sourceLifecycleReview.riverOwner: Retire disables/detaches the pending probe and defers Destroy for its target; it does not explicitly Release a live render target. Automatic native cancellation/retirement remains unacknowledged, so source review alone cannot prove safe or unsafe native completion.
sourceLifecycleReview.warningCause: UNPROVEN. Eight native-reflection-loop stacks justify discriminating automatic-probe versus explicit-river capture observations. They do not establish a seven-probe burst as the sole cause.

optionalTrace.guard: Requires existing explicit collection-control mode plus -cityProbeCollectionTrace; otherwise installs no trace. Actual Warning log type + native phrase only; it neither emits warnings nor changes LogAssert expectations.

bounds.overflowDisposition: Diagnostic attribution invalid, never a pass.

optionalTrace.observations: SRP camera begin/end snapshots, frame/time, current river epoch/request/target and automatic-probe origin matches; warning callback links to the currently active camera serial when available. Installed URP wraps non-game cameras in CameraRenderingScope at UniversalRenderPipeline.cs503–513.
optionalTrace.limits: Runtime correctness and tracing overhead are unrun. Trace snapshots and origin matches are not native request/cancellation acknowledgements. Delayed callbacks can leave active ownership unknown; tracing stops before helper cleanup while the whole raw log remains authoritative. Compare instrumented arms consistently and preserve an uninstrumented baseline.

applyPolicy: Root may apply exactly one of the primary or combined patches only after both the existing native run and its separate terminal order-guard reanalysis are complete. Preserve frozen source9532 through those final integrity checks. No patch has been applied; all graphics execution waits for GPU release. Do not substitute diagnostic disable, allocator flags, reduced quality or warning suppression for a production fix.
